  And

      (∀ {κ : Type u_3} {Ω : Type u_4} [Fintype κ] [inst : DecidableEq κ] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (G : Finset κ)
        (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (J : κ → Ω → Bool),

                        (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff
                          (Finset.prod (SDiff.sdiff G I) fun x =>

                    (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.expansion_totalMass
                      (Finset.prod (SDiff.sdiff G I) fun x =>
                        PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.expansion_bernoulli
                          (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.expansion_marginal μ J x)))
                    1))))
      (And
        (∀ {ι : Type u_5} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι] (M L : Nat) (g : ι → Nat),
          LT.lt 0 L →
            (∀ (i : ι), LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (g i) L) M) →

                            (HSub.hSub (HPow.hPow 2 (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.familyNullity L g)) 1)))
                        (And
                          (LE.le (abs (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.familyCentered L g))
                            (HMul.hMul (Finset.prod Finset.univ fun i => PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.marginal (g i) L)
                              (HPow.hPow 2 (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.familyNullity L g))))

                            Exists fun s => PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.FullRelation L g s)))))
        (And
          (∀ (L : Nat),
            LT.lt 0 L →
              ∀ (I : Finset Nat),
                Finset.Nonempty I →
                  And
                    (Eq (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.homogeneousMass L I)
                      (HMul.hMul
                        (Finset.prod I fun x =>
                          Inv.inv

          (And
            (∀ (C : Real),

                      ∀ (L : Nat),

                                    (HPow.hPow (Inv.inv (HPow.hPow 2 L)) (Finset.card I)))
                                  (HPow.hPow 2 (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.relativeNullity L I)))))
            (And
              (∀ (L : Nat),
                LT.lt 0 L →
                  ∀ (I : Finset Nat),
                    (∀ (x : Nat), Membership.mem I x → LT.lt 0 (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.marginal x L)) →
                      And
                        (LE.le (abs (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.centeredCoefficient L I))
                          (HMul.hMul
                            (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow 2 (Finset.card I))
                              (Finset.prod I fun x => PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.marginal x L))
                            (HPow.hPow 2 (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.compatibleNullity L I))))
                        (And
                          (LE.le (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.compatibleNullity L I)
                            (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.relativeNullity L I))
                          (LT.lt 0 (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.jointMoment L I) →

              (And
                (∀ {U : Type u_6} {ι : Type u_7} [inst : AddCommGroup U]

                  (S : ι → Submodule PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.F₂ U),
                  ExistsUnique fun P =>
                    And (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.RespectsRelations S P)
                      (∀ (Q : Finpartition Finset.univ),
                        PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.RespectsRelations S Q → LE.le P Q))
                (And
                  (∀ (L : Nat),
                    LT.lt 0 L →

                        have P :=

                                    PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.centeredCoefficient L

                                (Eq (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.relativeNullity L I)
                                  (Finset.sum (Finpartition.parts P) fun C =>
                                    PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.relativeNullity L
                                      (PaperP1Registry.Final.Affine.partImage C)))))))
                  (∀ (C u ε : Real),
                    LT.lt 0 u →
                      LT.lt 0 ε →
                        Exists fun N₀ =>

theorem PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.positive_hermite_approximation :
  And
    (∀ (μ α : Real),
      LT.lt 0 μ →
        Iff
          (And (∀ (k : Nat), LE.le 0 (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.quadraticMass μ α k))
            (HasSum (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.quadraticMass μ α) 1))
          (And (LE.le 0 α)
            (LE.le α
              (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul 2 (HPow.hPow μ 2))
                (HAdd.hAdd μ
                  (HMul.hMul (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.fractionalPart μ)
                    (HSub.hSub 1 (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.fractionalPart μ))))))))
    (And
      (∀ (μ α : Real),
        LT.lt 0 μ →
          ∀ (k : Nat),
            Eq (DFunLike.coe (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.signedReference μ α) (Singleton.singleton k))
              (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (Real.exp (Neg.neg μ)) (HPow.hPow μ k)) ↑(Nat.factorial k))
                (HAdd.hAdd 1
                  (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv α (HMul.hMul 2 (HPow.hPow μ 2)))
                    (HSub.hSub (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub (↑k) μ) 2) ↑k)))))
      (And
        (∀ (C ε : Real),
          LT.lt 0 ε →
            Exists fun N₀ =>
              And (LE.le 10 N₀)
                (∀ (N : Nat),
                  GE.ge N N₀ →
                    ∀ (L : Nat),
                      LE.le (abs (HSub.hSub (↑L) (HDiv.hDiv (Real.log ↑N) (Real.log 2)))) C →
                        Exists fun hα =>
                          Exists fun hαμ =>
                            And
                              (LE.le
                                (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.distance
                                  (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.sourceSigned N L)
                                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.toSignedMeasure
                                    (MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure
                                      (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.hermiteLaw
                                        (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.actualMean N L)
                                        (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.secondCumulant N L) hα hαμ))))
                                (HPow.hPow (↑N) (HAdd.hAdd (-4 / 3) ε)))
                              (LE.le
                                (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.totalVariation N L
                                  (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.hermiteLaw
                                    (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.actualMean N L)
                                    (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.secondCumulant N L) hα hαμ))
                                (HPow.hPow (↑N) (HAdd.hAdd (-4 / 3) ε)))))
        (And
          (∀ (h : Nat),
            LE.le 3 h →
              ∀ (C ε : Real),
                LT.lt 0 ε →
                  Exists fun N₀ =>
                    And (LE.le 2 N₀)
                      (∀ (N : Nat),
                        GE.ge N N₀ →
                          ∀ (L : Nat),
                            LE.le (abs (HSub.hSub (↑L) (HDiv.hDiv (Real.log ↑N) (Real.log 2)))) C →
                              Exists fun hα =>
                                Exists fun hαμ =>
                                  LE.le
                                    (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.distance
                                      (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.sourceSigned N L)
                                      (MeasureTheory.Measure.toSignedMeasure
                                        (MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure
                                          (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.hermiteLaw
                                            (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.nominalMean N L)
                                            (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.coefficient N L h) hα hαμ))))
                                    (HPow.hPow (↑N) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (-1) (HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑(HAdd.hAdd h 1))) ε))))
          (∀ (h : Nat),
            LE.le 3 h →
              ∀ (C τ : Real),
                LT.lt 0 τ →
                  Exists fun N₀ =>
                    And (LE.le 2 N₀)
                      (∀ (N : Nat),
                        GE.ge N N₀ →
                          ∀ (L : Nat),
                            LE.le (abs (HSub.hSub (↑L) (HDiv.hDiv (Real.log ↑N) (Real.log 2)))) C →
                              Exists fun hα =>
                                Exists fun hαμ =>
                                  And (LT.lt 0 (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.leadingGap N L h))
                                    (LE.le
                                      (abs
                                        (HSub.hSub
                                          (HDiv.hDiv
                                            (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.totalVariation N L
                                              (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.hermiteLaw
                                                (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.nominalMean N L)
                                                (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.coefficient N L h) hα hαμ))
                                            (HDiv.hDiv
                                              (HMul.hMul (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.phaseMass N L (HAdd.hAdd h 1))
                                                (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.secondNorm
                                                  (PaperP1Registry.Final.Reference.nominalMean N L)))
                                              4))
                                          1))
                                      τ))))))

theorem PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.fixed_moment_barrier :
  And
    (∀ (m : Nat),
      LE.le 3 m →
        ∀ (a : Real),
          LE.le 0 a →
            LE.le a 1 →
              And (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.IsProbabilityMass (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.baseMass a))
                (And
                  (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.IsProbabilityMass
                    (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.perturbedMass m a))
                  (And
                    (∀ (k : Nat),
                      And
                        (LE.le (HDiv.hDiv (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.baseMass a k) 2)
                          (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.perturbedMass m a k))
                        (LE.le (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.perturbedMass m a k)
                          (HMul.hMul (3 / 2) (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.baseMass a k))))
                    (And
                      (∀ (j : Nat),
                        And
                          (Summable fun k =>
                            HMul.hMul (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.perturbedMass m a k) ↑(Nat.descFactorial k j))
                          (And
                            (Summable fun k =>
                              HMul.hMul (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.baseMass a k) ↑(Nat.descFactorial k j))
                            (Iff
                              (Eq
                                (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.factorialMoment
                                  (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.perturbedMass m a) j)
                                (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.factorialMoment
                                  (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.baseMass a) j))
                              (Ne j m))))
                      (And
                        (Eq
                          (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.variation
                            (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.perturbedMass m a)
                            (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.baseMass a))
                          (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub 1 (HDiv.hDiv a 2)) (HPow.hPow 2 (HSub.hSub m 2)))
                            (HMul.hMul (Real.exp 1) ↑(Nat.factorial m))))
                        (∀ (t : Real),
                          LE.le 0 t →
                            And
                              (Summable fun k =>
                                HMul.hMul (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.perturbedMass m a k)
                                  (Real.exp (HMul.hMul t ↑k)))
                              (LE.le
                                (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.exponentialMoment
                                  (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.perturbedMass m a) t)
                                (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.exponentialBound t))))))))
    (And
      (∀ (N : Nat),
        And (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.IsProbabilityMass (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.familyMass N))
          (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.IsProbabilityMass (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.referenceMass N)))
      (And
        (∀ (r : Nat),
          Filter.Eventually
            (fun N =>
              And
                (Summable fun k =>
                  HMul.hMul (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.familyMass N k) ↑(Nat.descFactorial k r))
                (Eq
                  (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.factorialMoment (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.familyMass N) r)
                  (HAdd.hAdd 1 (HMul.hMul (↑(Nat.choose r 2)) (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.parameter N)))))
            Filter.atTop)
        (And
          (∀ (t : Real),
            LE.le 0 t →
              Filter.Eventually
                (fun N =>
                  And
                    (Summable fun k =>
                      HMul.hMul (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.familyMass N k) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul t ↑k)))
                    (LE.le
                      (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.exponentialMoment
                        (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.familyMass N) t)
                      (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.exponentialBound t)))
                Filter.atTop)
          (And
            (Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop
              (fun N =>
                HAdd.hAdd (Real.log (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.familyDistance N))
                  (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (1 / 2) (Real.sqrt (Real.log ↑N))) (Real.log (Real.log ↑N))))
              fun N => Real.sqrt (Real.log ↑N))
            (∀ (γ : Real),
              LT.lt 0 γ →
                Exists fun N₀ =>
                  ∀ (N : Nat),
                    GE.ge N N₀ →
                      LT.lt (HPow.hPow (↑N) (Neg.neg γ)) (PaperP1Registry.Final.Obstruction.familyDistance N))))))

surface.module_doc:
# Uniform arithmetic event structure and positive reference limits

This contained project preserves the original mathematical models and every
clause of the seven unregistered main results 2.1--2.5, 7.1 and 8.4.
Routine reference calibration is integrated into the quantitative result family.
Companion T13.1 supplies the uniform all-cardinality support count;
T15.1 and its displayed asymptotic corollary expose the fixed-moment barrier.
Model foundations retain their Paper C attribution: commit
b9fa9ba490f201b408a302a86f1594ee620b228b, Apache-2.0; docs/PAPER_C_REUSE.md.
All literal models precede theorem proof elaboration in both modules.
